name: no fox season
source:
One rainy day you come home from the store and find a wounded fox on the road. In spite of your strict parents who forbid you to have pets, you decide to take her in.

Can you take good care of her if you don't even know what foxes eat?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3759670/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
某个阴雨绵绵的日子里，你从商店买完东西回家，在路边发现了一只受伤的狐狸。尽管严厉的父母明令禁止饲养宠物，你还是决定偷偷将她带回家收留。

连狐狸平时吃什么都一窍不通的你，当真能把她悉心照顾好吗？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3759670/]Steam[/url]]
